news.title: Update 1.0.2.0 - Official Servers, Anti Cheat, Optimizations + Fixes & More
lines: Update 1.0.2.0 Patch Notes
Official Servers: You can now find 40+ official Hood Warfare 2 servers protected by Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC). Players should experience significantly better ping and fewer cheaters.
TheStrip Map Update: Added new buildings and improved the layout for better balance. Snipers should have a harder time spawn camping, with long sightlines limited to narrower roads.
FPS Optimizations: Improved performance on lower-end hardware. Players with lower-end systems should see an FPS boost. Especially on some low-performing maps like TheTrenches
More Customizable Create Game: You can now choose to rotate maps and game modes or stick to a specific map and mode.

Easy Anti-Cheat Re-enabled: EAC was temporarily disabled in the previous update due to compatibility issues. It is now fully active on official servers. We've also reviewed reports and banned many confirmed cheaters. Please continue reporting suspicious players.
Fixed gray bar getting stuck on screen when creating a game.
Added a confirmation UI when quitting the game.
Fixed weapon pickup UI getting stuck on screen.
Fixed issues with picking up weapons.
Blocked firing when aiming directly into a mesh.
Removed the Chicago Mall door leading outside.
Claymores are now destroyed when their owner dies.
Fixed invisible players.
Quick Play Update: You can now select your preferred game mode!
Added time limits to rounds.
Grenades now properly pass through barriers on Suburbs.
Fixed various issues with the Suburbs map.
Nerfed shotguns.
Fixed an issue where shooting or meleeing could completely prevent players from shooting, running, or switching weapons.
Fixed killstreak UI disappearing.
Fixed an issue where players could become unable to shoot after recently stopping fire.
Grenades now properly pass through world borders.
Fixed an exploit allowing players to despawn the bomb/bag.
Fixed several exploits (ifykyk).
Plus many more minor map improvements and fixes!
Developer Note:

If you're not seeing a update, make sure you fully restart steam (top left in steam app - exit steam) and your game should show the update pending. The bottom righty corner of your game should say 1.0.2.0 as the version.

Thanks to everyone who helped test all these fixes in the beta on discord. If you're interested in testing future updates make sure to join the discord testing channel. Expect many more content updates to come, including character customization, prestige, more skins, more maps & more in the following weeks/months.
-Trap$tar

news.title: 1.0.1.8 - 2 NEW GUNS - Draco & Arp + Bug Fixes
lines: 1.0.1.8 - 2 NEW GUNS - Draco + Arp + Many More
2 New Weapons Added - Draco and the ARP
All guns spawn with +1 more clip of ammo than they did before
Fixed exploit with the homies where they can clip through the ceiling of some maps
Fixed the homies colors to be red on chaos (matching your gang now)
Adjusted Chain snatch to go to 75 points instead of 100 to account for the change below
Changed behavior on chain snatch for retrieving own teams chain, it no longer gains a point towards your team so losing teams cant win by collecting own teammates
Reworked grenade to be much more powerful + redid explosion effects on grenade
Netcode reworks with microphones fixing crashes and other issues
Significantly increased the health of drive-by killstreak, much more health by default
Renamed bomber to “Crashout” killsteak
Adjusted UI so level up text and killstreaks don’t overlap
+Many more minor fixes and small text adjustments
Stay tuned, were listening to yalls feedback and continuing to make the game better. Many more updates to come
-Trap$tar

news.title: 1.0.10 - Anti Cheat + Voice Chat + Bug Fixes/Spawn Adjustments
lines: HOOD WARFARE 2 - PATCH 1.0.10
VOICE CHAT ADDED
You can talk to the whole lobby (or just your team) via voice chat. See settings where you can modify some preferences such as push to talk (on by default by pressing T) or open mic
ANTI CHEAT ADDED

Many of yall addressed concerns over cheating so we implemented an anti cheat system to hopefully prevent some of it. If you see a cheater, please use the “Report” feature in the pause menu as well. We review the reports often so if a player gets a lot of reports and we deem them to be cheating they will be banned.
Spawns adjusted + Spawn Protection

We addressed many of the spawn concerns that were brought up in this update hopefully making it so yall dont die instantly. Some maps are inherently very small, so the TTK will be short on maps like supermarket, but you should notice its overall better.
10+ Bug Fixes + Quality of Life Improvements

Fixed tons of minor/major bug fixes, mostly involving loadout presets not saving, progression not properly showing on end of match sometimes, player selection not saving, ping not showing accurately in join match screen, and many more. Also adjusted drive by locations on some maps. If yall see any more bugs be sure to report them in the discord.
DEVELOPER NOTE

Thank yall for all the support on launch weekend of Hood Warfare 2. Been hyped to see all the support on the game and we been working hard on making it better. Stay tuned as this is one of many updates to come.
